_comment: Tunable parameters for scene assembly and simulation launch.

kitchen_scale.description: Uniform scale applied to the World Labs kitchen shell. Increased from 1.25 to 1.47 so that NVIDIA fixtures at natural MuJoCo scale (1.0) fit proportionally — previously fixtures were 0.85x which broke PhysX articulation. World Labs output is ~2.5m wide; at 1.47x → ~3.7m wide, comfortably fitting standard appliances.

ground_plane_size.description: Ground plane dimensions in meters. Slightly larger to match increased kitchen scale.

camera.description: Initial viewport camera position (eye) and look-at (target). Move speed controls WASD navigation rate (default Isaac Sim is ~1.0, lower = slower). 0.01 is good for a ~3m kitchen.

g1_spawn.description: G1 robot spawn position. Final Z = kitchen_floor_z * kitchen_scale + pelvis_offset_z. Position [0,0,0] = center of kitchen.

kitchen_floor_z.description: Z coordinate of the kitchen floor in the unscaled mesh (after Y-to-Z axis swap). Used to compute G1 spawn height.
